{{Quote|Padawan&hellip; turn back. Leave this place&mdash;leave me. I am dying.|translated=1|Laotah|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Laotah''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. One of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assigned to guard the ruins of [[Kaleth]] on the Order's [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Laotah [[Death/Legends|lost his life]] at the hands of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s when he attempted to investigate activity in the area. Before his death, he warned the [[Hero of Tython|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] of the Flesh Raiders' power, and the Padawan recovered the fallen Selkath's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from Laotah's killers.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Surveillance monitors picked up Flesh Raiders entering this ruin. Came to investigate. Shouldn't have come alone.|translated=1|Laotah|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]], Laotah was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="TOR" /> serving during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Many years before<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Master Vinyor Tesh}}</ref> the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Laotah was visiting the Selkath [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] when it was [[Devastation of Manaan|attacked]] by the Empire, which destroyed all of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface developments. Laotah survived the assault and rescued the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] child [[Vinyor Tesh]], and, as the child had been orphaned in the bombardment, Laotah brought him to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where Tesh was given a job in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]].<ref name="Codex" />

[[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the later stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed the Great Galactic War, Laotah resided on the ancestral Jedi [[Planet/Legends|homeworld]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order. On Tython, Laotah was stationed at the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]], where he was part of a complement of Knights watching over the ruins of the ancient [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] temple of [[Kaleth]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising]], Laotah saw security images of [[Flesh Raider]]s establishing a base in the [[Forsaken Den]], one of the caves near Kaleth. Seeking out the answers to the Flesh Raiders attacks alone, he believed that the Flesh Raiders had a connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], thus provoking their attacks on the Order. However, Laotah was unprepared for the Flesh Raiders' use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and was grievously wounded by the Flesh Raiders&mdash;[[Flesh Raider Bladewielder|one]] of whom stole his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

Laotah limped to the cave's entrance, where he encountered the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]. Warning the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the Flesh Raiders' power and their possession of his lightsaber, Laotah succumbed to his injuries and [[Death/Legends|died]]. The Padawan, who had been [[Raid on the Forsaken Den|sent to drive]] the Flesh Raiders out of the cave, was able to complete Laotah's mission and recover the Knight's weapon from the Flesh Raiders, though the Padawan was forced to damage the Selkath's saber beyond repair during the fight with the Flesh Raider who had stolen it.<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Turn back. The enemy's too strong. They have my lightsaber&hellip;|translated=1|Laotah's dying words|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:LaotahSaber.png|thumb|right|200px|Laotah's lightsaber in the hands of his killer]]
A Selkath with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and blue-gray skin, Laotah was one of a handful of Knights who were deemed strong enough to withstand the lure of the dark side present in Kaleth and assigned to guard the ruins. An introspective Jedi, Laotah attempted to learn what drove the Flesh Raiders to violence, but underestimated the danger that the Flesh Raiders presented. His lack of preparation resulted in his death, but Laotah fulfilled his duty in his final moments by passing on his mission to Orgus Din's apprentice. Laotah constructed a blue-bladed lightsaber during his training, which was stolen by the Flesh Raider who killed the Selkath. The lightsaber was later recovered when Orgus Din's apprentice defeated Laotah's killer.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Laotah was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears in the Jedi Knight mission "Dark Temptations," in which the player is sent to destroy a Flesh Raider base within a cave in the ruins of Kaleth. Upon entering the cave, the player will encounter the wounded Laotah, who warns the Padawan that the Flesh Raiders within can use the dark side, and that they have taken his lightsaber. After Laotah dies at the end of the conversation, the player continues into the cave and defeats the Flesh Raiders within, eventually facing the Flesh Raider Bladewielder who uses Laotah's lightsaber against the Knight. The lightsaber can be recovered from the Bladewielder's body, but it is damaged beyond repair.<ref name="TOR" />
